display_long_description:
AUTODESK WORKSHOP XR LICENSE REQUIRED FOR USE. Start your free trial at http://www.autodesk.com/workshopxr
 
**Autodesk Workshop XR** is an immersive workspace that helps AEC teams review and coordinate project models together at human scale before construction begins.

Connected directly to Autodesk Forma through Forma Data Management, Workshop XR helps teams access Revit, Navisworks, and IFC models, collaborate in VR, and capture issues in context—so review outcomes stay connected to coordination workflows.

# Capabilities

- Load Revit, Navisworks, and IFC models from Forma Data Management projects into VR
- Meet with team members in a shared immersive workspace
- Review projects together at human scale or dollhouse scale
- Access project files, members, and issue data through Forma Data Management
- Create and manage issues in VR
- Capture spatial feedback in context
- Take 3D measurements
- Inspect model properties
- Join an active Workshop XR session from a web browser

# Access note

**For licensed users only.** Visit autodesk.com/workshopxr to learn more and request a free trial.
